2607.19126.title: Parallel Noising in Neural Markov Logic Networks
2607.19126.paper_summary: Neural Markov Logic Networks (NMLNs) are a flexible neurosymbolic relational model. Previous work has shown that, although NMLNs achieve strong performance as generative models for small relational structures, they underperform diffusion-based generative graph models on larger structures. In this paper, we strengthen NMLNs along two main dimensions: (i) we increase the expressive capacity of their potential functions using graph neural networks, and (ii) we develop a new training and inference algorithm inspired by parallel-tempering Markov chain Monte Carlo methods, which we name parallel noising. Together, these enhancements enable NMLNs to attain strong performance in graph generation relative to general diffusion-based generative graph models. Furthermore, they allow NMLNs to match the performance of specialized text-based recurrent models when generating small molecular structures.
2607.19126.paper_summary_zh: 神經馬可夫邏輯網絡（NMLNs）是一種靈活的神經符號關係模型。先前的研究顯示，儘管NMLNs在小型關係結構中作為生成模型表現強勁，但在較大型結構上，它們的表現不如基於擴散的生成圖模型。在本文中，我們從兩個主要方面加強NMLNs：（i）我們使用圖神經網絡增加其潛在函數的表達能力，並且（ii）我們開發了一種新的訓練和推斷算法，靈感來自平行退火馬可夫鏈蒙特卡羅方法，我們稱之為平行噪聲。這些增強使NMLNs在圖生成方面相對於一般的基於擴散的生成圖模型達到強勁的表現。此外，它們還使NMLNs在生成小型分子結構時能夠匹配專門的基於文本的循環模型的表現。
